title: 孤城逐晓 · 封闭测试
description: 四人协作塔防与生存。建造城防、培养英雄，应对不断增强的怪物波次，并挑战无尽模式。本条目用于受限测试，暂不开放真实付费。
notes: Updates the same owner-approved unlisted item. The title, description, cover, four-account roster and visibility remain the reviewed values.
Contains only the signed game runtime. Author tools, CMD launchers, output caches, editable art, source CSV and local connector credentials are not distributed.
Steam web authorization uses the player account and explicit per-match consent; it does not require a Valve dedicated-server pairing key or a player-side connection assistant.
Profiles remain in the independent four-account WS4 test database. Real-money payments and trusted rankings remain disabled.
The production release and protected server policy reject project cheat/debug mutations. Ordinary Workshop engine cheat settings still require native room verification.
The author PC must stay online for the temporary fixed Steam TLS egress relay. Web authorization does not provide multiplayer hosting or remove host/VPN latency.

The frozen v04 diagnostic candidate passed a native non-Tools isolated-addon test with real player approval, profile loading and map admission. Original Workshop lobby behavior remains a separate retest.
WS4-WEB-04 exposes only fixed request phase/stage/status diagnostics, handles explicit Send=false and callback timeouts, and never publishes device codes, bearer tokens or response bodies.
